title: Stereotype or Personalization? User Identity Biases Chatbot Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the demographic alignment, diversity, and representativeness of LLM-recommended entities (universities and neighborhoods) to real-world U.S. census and government data when a user's racial identity (White, Black, Hispanic, or Asian) is revealed explicitly or implicitly.

Measuring differences in model recommendations and the presence of stereotypical explanations when user prompts are written using demographically-linked dialects (e.g., African American English, Chicano English) versus Standard American English.

Evaluating shifts in model output when user prompts contain implicit identity disclosures via references to stereotypically or demographically associated cultural entities (e.g., attending an HBCU, playing specific sports).
